entities.name: İsmet Uluğ
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: İsmet Uluğ was a Turkish boxer and football player of rivals Galatasaray and Fenerbahçe. Born in Istanbul, he played as a midfielder and winger and was nicknamed Yavuz İsmet.
